ayahs.text: حمٓ
ayahs.translation: Ha. Mim

ayahs.text: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.translation: By the Scripture that maketh plain

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning

ayahs.text: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: Whereon every wise command is made clear

ayahs.text: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
ayahs.translation: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending

ayahs.text: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.translation: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower

ayahs.text: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure

ayahs.text: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translation: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers

ayahs.text: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.translation: Nay, but they play in doubt

ayahs.text: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translation: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

ayahs.text: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.translation: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment

ayahs.text: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers

ayahs.text: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translation: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them

ayahs.text: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
ayahs.translation: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman

ayahs.text: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief)

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.translation: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger

ayahs.text: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
ayahs.translation: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

ayahs.text: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translation: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant

ayahs.text: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
ayahs.translation: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death

ayahs.text: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.translation: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go

ayahs.text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk

ayahs.text: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.translation: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed

ayahs.text: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
ayahs.translation: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host

ayahs.text: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.translation: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind

ayahs.text: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

ayahs.text: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
ayahs.translation: And pleasant things wherein they took delight

ayahs.text: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.translation: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk

ayahs.text: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.translation: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
ayahs.translation: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom

ayahs.text: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.translation: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translation: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures

ayahs.text: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translation: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial

ayahs.text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying

ayahs.text: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
ayahs.translation: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again

ayahs.text: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth

ayahs.text: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty

ayahs.text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.translation: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play

ayahs.text: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not

ayahs.text: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.translation: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped

ayahs.text: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.translation: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful

ayahs.text: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.translation: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum

ayahs.text: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
ayahs.translation: The food of the sinner

ayahs.text: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
ayahs.translation: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

ayahs.text: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.translation: As the seething of boiling water

ayahs.text: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translation: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell

ayahs.text: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water

ayahs.text: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
ayahs.translation: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble

ayahs.text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
ayahs.translation: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured

ayahs.text: فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.translation: Amid gardens and watersprings

ayahs.text: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.translation: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another

ayahs.text: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
ayahs.translation: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

ayahs.text: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.translation: They call therein for every fruit in safety

ayahs.text: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translation: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell

ayahs.text: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.translation: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph

ayahs.text: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.translation: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed

ayahs.text: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.translation: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting
